title: EscalationV1
description: One agent->human push: a run parked for judgment. Exactly one line per park. Carries why it parked, under which verdict (and grant, when the parking tool ran under one), about which PR, the plain-language brief for a zero-context approver, and — once a human decides — the resolution that closes the agent->human->agent loop with provenance. The typed replacement for the untyped body gate wrote and two readers redeclared.

outcome.description: Gate's outcome string for the park (today always parked_for_judgment). Leads a notification title, so it is part of the wire shape.

verdict.description: The reduced verdict id the park stands on — provenance the inbox reads to build a paste-ready command.

grant.description: The grant id the run ran under, when the park arose from a granted run. Optional since the second consumer arrived: a park raised by a tool holding no grant (roxiq's sanity floor, which had to fill the then-required field with a none:roxiq-is-not-a-gate-run sentinel) omits it instead of inventing a value. Consumers that resolve THROUGH a grant keep their own law: the resolution back-channel still refuses a grantless resolve, so the ceiling re-applies on resolve — that check lives with the consumer, where it always belonged.

question.description: The park reason a zero-context reader sees first. An escalation with no question is a page with no ask.

run_id.description: The gate run this park belongs to. Optional and additive: the envelope already carries the run, but a self-contained body resolves it without the envelope.

code.description: The machine-readable park code. Absent on a content park (which carries a brief instead); present on the procedural parks. Values equal gate's own persisted park codes, so the typed body changed no wire value.

repo.description: The PR's repo (owner/name), when the park names one.

number.description: The PR number, when the park names one — with repo, a direct click-target for the sink.

brief.description: The one-screen plain-language page for a zero-context approver, translated from findings. Optional: procedural parks and synthesis failures carry none. Field names mirror gate's verify.Brief exactly.

escape.description: The runnable route Gate printed for this park, sealed into the artifact body so state alone can reconstruct the next step.

self_gated.description: True when repairing this terminal state requires changing the automated component that failed.

retry_helps.description: Whether repeating the identical invocation can change this terminal state.

resolution.description: The closed-loop stamp: decision, who, when, and the judgment it produced. It is NEVER written into the immutable park artifact (the log is append-only) — the back-channel appends a standalone resolution artifact, and this embedded field is the projected view a reader fills by joining that artifact back to the escalation. Its shape doubles as the body of that standalone artifact. Absent on every real park body today; a projection is the only thing that populates it.

decision.description: The human's decision, mirroring gate's verdict vocabulary.

method.description: The channel the decision arrived through: cli-operator, slack-interactive, or auto-<provider>. Optional so resolutions stamped before the field existed still validate; the write path refuses a new one without it. It names the channel, never an authenticated claim.

at.description: When the decision was recorded, RFC 3339 UTC.

judgment_id.description: The id of the KindJudgment artifact this decision produced — the link from the resolution to the effect gate recorded.
